title: What an Agent Should Remember: Retrieval, Compression, and Experience
outcome: Choose fresh valid records and inspect action preservation under compression.
prerequisites: The mapped chapter and its notation

input_fields.budget: Nonnegative integer token budget up to 10000.
input_fields.current_version: Current document or state version identifier.
input_fields.records: At most 20 records. Each has id,tokens:positive integer,decision_value:nonnegative number,timestamp,ttl:nonnegative numbers,authority:boolean,version:string.
input_fields.original_action_values: Finite values for each original decision alternative.

equations.label: EQV15-01
explanations: Equation (15.1) selects records by expected decision value under a stated context budget.
Include records only when expected decision improvement exceeds the decision-value-priced token cost within budget.
